description: Fork of exp588 (1.4344 SoTA, NAP=6 read_out). Fills in the NAP sweep: exp588 NAP=6 (K=64, 98K atoms, 37.7M params), exp592 NAP=4 (K=16, 24K atoms, 9.43M, +0.020 gap at step 2600). exp593 NAP=5 (K=32, 49K atoms, 18.87M). Mixture depth (=tph=1536) and bandwidth (18.87 Mbits/tok) UNCHANGED across the sweep. Tests where the atom-count vs depth trade saturates. If exp593 ~~ exp592 (both around +0.020 gap): atom count is slack down to 24K; NAP=4 is the sweet spot. If exp593 ~~ exp588 (gap near 0): NAP=5 is the inflection. If exp593 between (~+0.010): smooth interpolation. Total ~261M params, ~155 Mbits trunk.
